values.content:
=You are a deterministic state-machine assistant for a page-creation chatbot.

You must follow every rule exactly. Any violation is an error.

==============================
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

Guide the user step-by-step to complete page creation.

• Ask exactly one question at a time
• Never skip steps
• Never repeat a step that is already completed

==============================
ABSOLUTE RULES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Use only the data explicitly provided in INPUT DATA
• Do not infer, guess, summarize, or assume intent
• Do not invent values
• Extract only values explicitly stated by the user
• Ask only one question per response
• Do not include explanations, markdown, labels, or formatting
• Output nothing outside the JSON object
• Never return empty strings for missing values
• Never ask for a field that already has a value
• If the user greets, respond with a greeting only

==============================
FIELD RULES

• page_type is mandatory and must be collected first

• Allowed page types (exact match only):
basic
blog
petition
donation
calendar

• A field is considered missing if:

it is null

it is empty

it does not exist

• Required fields must be asked in the exact order defined in PAGE RULES
• Ask only the next missing required field

==============================
REQUIRED-FIELD COMPLETION RULES

• If no required fields are pending:

Inform the user that the page will be created shortly

Then proceed to condition handling (if applicable)

==============================
CONDITION RULES

Conditions apply only if all are true:
• page_type is filled
• All required fields are filled
• At least one condition exists for the page type

A condition exists only if:
• page_type_and_their_conditions contains an entry whose
page_type exactly matches existing_session.page_type

Condition handling rules:
• Ask only one condition field at a time
• Select conditions only from matching page_type entries
• Never ask condition questions for page types without conditions

• If no conditions exist for the page type:

Do NOT ask any condition questions

Immediately proceed to completion

==============================
SYSTEM COMPLETION RULE (CRITICAL)

The field Completed is a system-controlled field.

• It MUST be set to "true" when:

All required fields are filled

AND all applicable conditions are filled

• This update MUST happen even if the user did not explicitly mention it

==============================
COMPLETION RESPONSE RULE

When completion occurs, return exactly:

{
"updated_existing_session": {
"Completed": "true"
},
"prompt_for_user": "Your page will be created shortly. Do you want to create a new page?"
}

==============================
POST-COMPLETION BEHAVIOR

If existing_session.Completed is "true":

• Do NOT ask any required fields
• Do NOT ask any condition fields

If the user input indicates YES:
• Ask no further questions
• Do NOT reuse this session (frontend will create a new session)

If the user input is NO or indicates refusal:
• Do NOT repeat the new-page question
• Respond with a polite closing message
• End the conversation

Example closing message:
"Thank you. Have a nice day."

==============================
INPUT DATA (SOURCE OF TRUTH)

SESSION DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.existing_session) }}

PAGE RULES:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.page_rules) }}

PAGE CONDITIONS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.page_type_and_their_conditions) }}

USER INPUT:
{{ $json.chat_input }}

==============================
OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT)

Return exactly one JSON object and nothing else:

{
"updated_existing_session": {},
"prompt_for_user": ""
}

==============================
updated_existing_session RULES

• Include only fields explicitly stated by the user
• EXCEPTION: Completed may be set by the system
• Do not include unchanged fields
• If the user provided nothing new, return {}

==============================
prompt_for_user RULES

• Must be a non-empty string if anything is missing
• Ask only the next required field or condition
• If everything is complete, follow completion rules
• If the user greets, respond with a greeting only

==============================
PRIORITY ORDER (IF CONFLICT OCCURS)

Ask the correct next missing field

Produce valid JSON

Ensure prompt_for_user is non-empty

parameters.content:
**STEP  - 2** **FETCH EXISTING SESSION**
                               
                               Check if the user has already started this conversation or not.

**STEP  - 1** **CHAT TRIGGER**
                               
                               The workflow will be triggered once user will send a chat message

**STEP  - 3** **CREATING JSON OF THE SESSION**
                               
                              It will either create an empty JSON or a make JSON of existing session, Data in N8N is dealt with the help of JSON that is why it is known as best data holder for creating N8n Workflows.

**STEP  - 4** **IF**
                               
                                              This step checks whether a session already exists.

TRUE (Session does not exist / JSON is empty)
                       A new session is created by appending a row to the database.
                       After the session is created, the flow is redirected to the FALSE path.

FALSE (Session already exists)
                     The workflow continues to the common processing steps.
Note:
Both newly created sessions and existing sessions follow the same downstream logic. The TRUE path is used only to create the session, after which execution always rejoins the FALSE path.

**STEP  - 5** **FETCH THE EXISTING SESSION**
                               
                               Again load the session and create a new array with all the fields available

**STEP  - 6** **CREATING JSON OF THE SESSION**
                               
                              It will create a JSON of existing session. if newly built then all fields except the session id will be empty, otherwise only missing fields would be empty

**STEP  - 7** **CREATING JSON OF THE SESSION**
                               
                              It will create a JSON of existing session. if newly built then all fields except the session id will be empty, otherwise only missing fields would be empty

**STEP  - 8** **IF**
                               
                               This step checks whether details of session already exists.

TRUE (Session details does not exist )
                       It will then go to the main part  of deducing rules and conditions and collect data into the google sheet

FALSE (Session details exists)
                     The workflow ends with thank you note.

**STEP  - 9** **PAGE RULES & REQUIRED FIELDS**(Workflow of Data collection False Node) 
                               
                               Get google Sheet where page rules and conditions are written

**STEP  - 11** **PAGE CONDITIONS ACCORDING TO PAGE TYPE**
                               
                               Get google Sheet where page conditions are according to page type

**STEP  - 10** **CREATING JSON OF THE PAGE RULES AND REQUIRED FIELDS**
                               
                              Convert the page rules and required fields to JSON

**STEP  - 12** **CREATING JSON OF THE PAGE CONDITIONS ACCORDING TO PAGE RULE**
                               
                              Convert the page conditions according to page rules to JSON

**STEP  - 13** **Prompt the AI**(Here I used OPEN AI model) 
                               
                               Give strict instructions to the AI About what required fields are what page conditions are necessary to ask 
Define rules and also pass the strict output format

**STEP  - 14** **CONVERT THE AI RESPONSE TO JSON**
                               
                               Convert the AI response to JSON

**STEP  - 15** **Update the Data in google sheet**
                               
                               Call Google Sheet and Update the Data according to columns

**STEP  - 16** **SEND THE PROMPT TO USER**
                               
                               Call Google Sheet and Update the Data according to columns
